notes.title: New Mission Type : Armada
notes.content:
Armada
Discover the new Fleet-type missions in this update!

Join an allied fleet and confront enemies, engage in intense battles with up to 10 vs. 10, and strive to tip the scales for victory!
Bug Fixes
Clicking the objective text no longer opens the galaxy map.

The bug that made certain allies or enemies invincible has been fixed (to be confirmed).

Have fun! :)

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content: Added backup saves, so corrupted saves should no longer be an issue

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
New animation for thrusters: all thrusters will now animate based on the ship's speed.
 Bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Lights and Planetary Scans
notes.content:
Update Notes:
Enhanced Lighting Effects: Planets now glow with hued light and lens flares. Projectiles and thrusters emit dynamic glows, while stations and ships feature blinking or static hull lights, adding atmospheric depth.

New Feature (WIP): Research Points! Scan planets (once per planet) to earn points for future passive ship upgrades. Note: Spending points is not yet available, but you can start accumulating them.

Mission Threat Preview: Get a glimpse of enemy ships you'll face when selecting missions.

More content coming soon! Enjoy!

notes.title: Sound System Overhaul
notes.content:
The entire sound system of the game has been redesigned with high quality effects and music.

The minimap has been improved and optimised.

Several aspects of the game difficulty and progression have been rebalanced.

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
several adjustments to game balance and difficulty
 removed a few bugs

notes.title: New Mission Type: Convoy
notes.content:
New Mission Type: Convoy

Take on Convoy missions, where you protect up to 3 ships on their journey. The more ships that survive, the bigger your reward! Think of it like an escort mission, but with higher stakes.


Improved Arrow Indicators

Stay sharp with up to 3 arrow indicators, now showing target type and distance. Navigate the stars with better situational awareness!


Game Balance Adjustments
Reduced difficulty for late-game missions to keep the challenge fun and fair.

Boosted player ship health for more survivability.

Increased HP and shield HP for stations and escort ships, making them tougher allies.
Bug Fixes
Fixed the "floating" hyperdrive travel animation for smoother visuals.

Resolved an issue where background space tiles failed to load properly.

Enjoy and let me know what you think!

notes.title: Space Defender - Persistent Universe
notes.content:
New Features


 Deterministic Procedural Generation: Explore a more consistent and immersive universe with predictable planet and station generation.
 Persistent Galaxies: Planets and stations now retain their location, inventory, and credits between sessions for a seamless experience.
 Game Map: Press M to open the new galaxy map and navigate with ease!
 Enhanced Ship Combat: Aim and shoot freely in any direction (within limits), independent of ship rotation, for smoother and more dynamic battles.
 New Soundtrack: Enjoy 30 new music tracks! Check out the creators at alkakrab.itch.io.
 New Sound Effects: Fresh audio effects added (work in progress, more to come!).
 Low Health Warning: A red vignette screen effect now visually alerts you when your health is low.
 Dynamic Difficulty Scaling: New mechanism adjusts challenge based on your progress for a more balanced experience.
 Loading Screen: Added a loading screen for smoother transitions.

Improvements


 Early Game Economy: Increased the amount of credits that the early stations own.
 Pickable Objects: Improved collision detection makes picking up objects easier and more intuitive. Pickable objects also float for longer before disappearing!
 Large Ship Handling: Boosted rotation speed for large player ships, enhancing maneuverability.

Bug Fixes

Addressed various bugs to improve overall stability and gameplay experience.

Notes
Stay tuned for additional content updates!
I’d love to hear your feedback on the new features and improvements :)

notes.title: Massive update for Space Defender!
notes.content:
Infinite Space
Thanks to procedural generation, the game universe (space, stations, and planets) is dynamically generated in chunks around the player, making the universe virtually infinite — no more map boundaries!
> Performance is improved as only the area around the player needs to be loaded.

Improved Enemy AI
AI ships dynamically switch between different behaviors, such as:

 Navigate
 Attack
 Evade
 Keep Distance


Enhanced Targeting and Combat
Ships now adjust their shots with greater precision, making evasion maneuvers more challenging.
> Additionally, firing patterns vary based on distance: the farther you are, the wider the enemy shot spread.

Boom!
Explosions of large ships and stations have been significantly reworked for greater realism.

Refined Controls
Keyboard/mouse and gamepad controls have been reworked for smoother gameplay.
With keyboard/mouse, the ship automatically rotates toward the direction of movement.

Space Dust
Added a dynamic fog effect in space that moves and changes color.

Inventory Management
Jettison unwanted items into space and retrieve them if needed!

Optimized Code
The game’s codebase has been significantly improved to facilitate maintenance and future development.

Price Adjustment
To reflect the significant effort invested and the enhanced quality and scope of the game, a price increase will take effect soon.

And Also

 Station shops remain accessible even after starting a mission.
 Missions are now located closer to the player, reducing travel time.
 The arrow automatically points to the nearest station.
 Improved health and energy bars: Redesigned for better visibility and ergonomics.
 Part of the menu and text has been redesigned.
 New tutorial mission: Added an easy introductory mission to guide new players.
 Progressive difficulty: The first five missions offer increasing difficulty.
 Improved item visibility: Floating pickable items now emit a colored trail for better detection.
 Missile behavior: Expired missiles now explode properly instead of disappearing.
 Rebalancing of difficulty and equipment stats.
 And much more...

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: You can now reset your game progression from the main menu

notes.title: Space Defender - First Update!
notes.content:
Thanks to the valuable feedback of our first players, the first patch is here!

Here's what's included:


 Fixed: "Mission Accomplished" text now displays correctly (no more red text).
 Fixed: Buying a ship now properly deducts credits.
 Fixed: "Repair Ship" button turns green when available.
 Fixed: Added "Energy Too Low" warning and visual feedback.

 Fixed: Added recommendation for controller use in main menu.
 Fixed: Reduced music volume in the main menu.

notes.title: Space Defender Blasts into Early Access – Join the Galactic Adventure!
notes.content:
Greetings, Space Defenders!

I'm thrilled to announce that Space Defender, my indie 2D arcade space shooter, is now available in Early Access on Steam! Crafted with love in France, this twin-stick shooter blends fast-paced combat, RPG ship upgrades, and a relaxing open-world vibe.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1731170/extras/ExploreSpace.gif?t=1746489965

What’s in Early Access?
In this initial release, you can:  

Pilot your ship through dynamic top-down battles with intuitive twin-stick controls. Switch freely between your keyboard & mouse or your gamepad.
Wield diverse weapons like laser cannons, turrets, and guided missiles.  
Upgrade your ship with RPG-style progression, balance energy consumption, and buy better equipment.  
Explore three galaxies filled with stations and planets, with a chill, ambient atmosphere.
Buy more powerful ships with your hard-earned credits.
Play in English or French, with full localization.

Space Defender is built to run smoothly on low-end PCs and laptops, so everyone can join the fight!

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1731170/extras/Fight.gif?t=1746489965

Why Early Access?
As a small indie dev, I want your feedback to shape Space Defender’s future. Early Access lets me polish the game with you, adding new content, mission variety and features over the next 4–6 months. 

Join the Community!
Share feedback, report bugs, or suggest features in the Steam Discussions, or on our Discord Server.

Join our Discord

Special Launch Offer
To celebrate, Space Defender is 20% off for the first 2 weeks of Early Access! Grab it now for just $3.99 and start exploring the stars.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1731170/extras/Travel.gif?t=1746489965
 
About me
“I’m a solo dev from France, and Space Defender is my passion side-project. I poured countless hours into creating a space shooter that’s both thrilling and chill, with a nod to classic arcade games. This is also my first game, and I can’t wait to hear what you think!”

Ready to defend the cosmos?
